title: Base Who-Is canonical discovery request
purpose: Provide a conservative discovery seed with minimal BACnet/IP layering and a distinct broadcast-style unconfirmed request shape.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP endpoint may parse the BVLC and NPDU and treat the APDU as a basic discovery request that can trigger device advertisement responses.
constraints_preserved: Common BACnet/IP-style BVLC plus NPDU plus APDU layering retained
BVLC four-byte total length is internally consistent
issue_safety_notes: Constructed from fallible model prior only and kept conservative; no external issue knowledge or vulnerability claims are used.
